name: JPL Horizons lunar reference ephemeris
source: NASA JPL Horizons observer output, QUANTITIES=4,20

reference.note: Center-relative body positions reconstructed from reference observer's apparent azimuth, elevation, and distance. Any selected surface site is shifted by its position vector to calculate parallax; approximation remains due to reference frame, local relief, and apparent light-time.

frame: Moon-fixed center-relative position km (+X=90E equator, +Y=north, +Z=0E equator)
